title: Earliest bands he heard: the Imperial Band
summary: He recalls brass bands and orchestras in his youth, especially the Imperial Band and bassist Jimmy Brown.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Can you remember the earliest bands you ever heard or parades or what kind of music, dance music or any kind that you heard that way when you were a boy?

Oh, when I was a boy, I used to hear the old salsa band, you know. No, I don't know. Oh yeah, and this band Cross the River. Pacific? Pacific band, brass band, you know. The old time band. I was trying to call it the older bands, you know. The Armaged Band, you see. Well, I mean like an orchestra, I see.
Are you speaking of Robin? Any kind of music at all? Grass bands or orchestras? Do you remember some of the early orchestras you heard when you were really young?

Oh yeah, all the orchestras. We were only coming down to the orchestras in my younger days. And the band I always was crazy about was the Imperial Band and the Imperial, what was it? The Imperial Band, yeah. You know? Because, well I was pretty good sized then because I used to a lot of time pinch it for Brown. Oh yes. Used to play bass. James Brown was that his name?
He died basically. Jimmy Brown. Jimmy Brown, that's his name. And Oak Gasper and the Imperial Band.
